summary: This video breaks down OddOneGaming's six teams used to reach top rankings in Continental Challenge Season 8. He provides exact lineup compositions, key hero substitutes, positioning tips, and equipment synergies for each boss. Standout strategies include stacking Resistance with Feenja and Oggok against Iola, and locking down Amonleyda's ultimate energy using Phaessa and Orfenna. He also links imported team codes to easily copy stats and talents.

heroes.verdict: Core clone summoner for Aura teams
heroes.note: Generates clones that dramatically boost overall damage in Continental Challenge fights.

heroes.note: Fills a similar clone/summon role in Aura teams if Yfeir is unavailable.

heroes.name: Fathomdown
heroes.note: Constantly recycles ultimate skills to lock down boss energy and reduce recharge speed.

heroes.name: Maashtur

heroes.name: Irmoush
heroes.note: Substitutes well for Maashtur when extra survivability or shielding is required.

heroes.note: Offers solid healing while landing debuffs to negate Whisk's invisibility.

heroes.name: Oggok

heroes.name: Feenja
heroes.note: Shares 20% of high personal Resistance with adjacent allies using Stand United talent.

heroes.name: Phaessa

heroes.name: Orfenna
heroes.note: Consistently applies Electrocuted debuffs, continuously triggering Phaessa's energy drain passive.

heroes.name: Journ

meta_changes: Energy reduction strategies combining Phaessa passive, Punisher's Whip, and high-frequency debuffers offer reliable lock-down against high-damage bosses.
tips: Equip Stand United talent on both Oggok and Feenja and place allies adjacent to them to share Resistance against Iola.
Use Calcined Ruin 1-piece gear on ultimate debuffers like Journ to land additional Bleed debuffs.
Pair Phaessa with Punisher's Whip and Orchestral Harmony gear to stack Skill Haste and maximize energy reduction.
Position heroes wearing Everlasting Candleflame or Whirling Edge next to main damage dealers to maximize buff sharing.
